name: Old Broken Ancient Piggy: Intercity DEMO
desc:
Sign up for the official release here: https://www.roblox.com/events/5966839480366269041

Note: This is an outdated DEMO! The full game can be found here:
https://www.roblox.com/games/86852362398411/Piggy-Intercity

The full game of Piggy: Intercity will serve as the next major installment in the Piggy series following Book 2. Players will be able to freely explore a vast world, uncover its secrets, and shape their own unique story while surviving the many looming threats that stand in their way.

Credits:
Additional Scripting help: Optikk
Gun models: HannahB458
UI designs: Mischiefing
